indra: quick heads-up — spotted a regression in the INT8 kernel selection on sm90 during the latest canary. for long sequences the autotuner is choosing the fallback gemm path (gemm_unfused_sm90) instead of the new fused gemm-attn int8 kernel, causing ~2.3x token p99 latency. attaching small profiler excerpt.

sam: can you paste the profiler output + exact run command? i'll try a quick repro.

indra: repro command i used:
```
./run_bench --arch sm90 --model redwood-13b-qint8 --quant int8 --batch 1 --seq 4096 --warmups 20 --reps 50
```
prof output (trimmed):
```
seq=512   kernel=gemm_fused_int8_sm90    tokens/s=2600  med_tok_ms=3.8
seq=2048  kernel=gemm_unfused_sm90       tokens/s=700   med_tok_ms=14.2
seq=4096  kernel=gemm_unfused_sm90       tokens/s=320   med_tok_ms=31.9
KV cache hit ratio ~0.98, but per-step kernel launch overhead increases at seq>1024
```

perf-bot: autotuner decision log:
```
[autotuner] model=redwood-13b-qint8 arch=sm90 seq=4096 candidate_kernels=[gemm_fused_int8_sm90, gemm_unfused_sm90] cost_estimates=[12.4, 9.1] selected=gemm_unfused_sm90 reason="lower estimated memory pressure"
```

laura: hmm — looks like the cost model is overweighing memory pressure for sm90. the fused int8 kernel uses a tiled compute layout that reduces launch overhead but temporarily spikes workspace by ~20MB for seq>2k. autoscaler uses a hard threshold to avoid any workspace > X MB which is too conservative for sm90. we should add per-arch workspace allowances and a seq-dependent launch-overhead term.

alejandra: proposed quick patch: add a "seq_launch_penalty(seq, arch)" term that decays with tile_k and vector_width. default for sm90: tile_k=256, vector=32, seq_penalty = max(0, (seq/1024 - 1))*0.7. also allow workspace_headroom_sm90 = 1.25 (was global 1.0). will open PR with the heuristic.

sam: i'll run a sweep: tile_k in [128,256], vector in [16,32,64], workspace_headroom in [1.0,1.25,1.5], seq in [1024,2048,4096]. i'll post results in this thread.

indra: another note — KV cache eviction pattern: for batching + long seq we see more frequent LRU churn, that inflates memory observed by the tuner temporarily. suggest smoothing observed working set over a sliding window of 50 steps before feeding to cost model.

laura: agree. also for FP8 path we had a separate problem where a micro-kernel (fused_attn_fp8_sm90) loses vectorization for odd seq lengths. we should add parity-aware tile alignment to the autotuner so it prefers kernels that maintain vectorized inner loops.

perf-bot: quick aggregated baseline from canary cluster (eu-west, p4d-like nodes):
```
arch=sm90, model=13b-qint8, seq=4096, default-autotune -> p99_token_ms=120 (baseline), proposed-settings (tile_k=256, vector=32, wh=1.25) -> p99_token_ms=52
```

ops-bot: heads-up: dedicated customers on eu-west saw a small spike in latency after the canary — routing rule rollback queued. please coordinate before we push autotune change to prod. :warning:

alejandra: working on PR now. i'll include unit test for seq-dependent cost and a synthetic microbench that asserts kernel pick for seq>2048 is fused_int8 when workspace_headroom>=1.25 on sm90.

sam: running sweeps now, will upload raw csv to /mnt/perf/runs/1762001234-int8-sm90-sweep.csv once done.

indra: thanks — plan for this thread: (1) sam runs sweep and posts numbers, (2) laura + alejandra update tuner defaults for sm90, (3) add sliding-window smoothing for KV working set, (4) ops verifies rollback safety for Dedicated. aiming to roll to canary next week. :thumbsup:

laura: ack. i'll also add telemetry flags so we can see which kernel was chosen per-request in the call traces (per-route breakdown).

sam: uploaded results: link: https://internal.redwood/perf/1762001234 (csv + html). early numbers favor tile_k=256, vector=32. improvements 2.1x-2.6x p99 for seq>=2048.

indra: sweet. moving to PR review. thanks everyone.
